protocol.title: Dried Blood Spot Analysis by Digital Microfluidics Coupled to Nanoelectrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF) coupled to nanoelectrospray ionization mass spectrometry (nESI-MS)
protocol.sample_type: Dried blood spot (DBS) on Whatman 903 filter paper
protocol.objective: Automated on-chip extraction, derivatization, and nESI-MS/MS quantification of succinylacetone (SA) as a biomarker for hepatorenal tyrosinemia (HT, tyrosinemia type 1) from 3.2 mm DBS punches; extended protocol also enables parallel amino acid analysis

layers: Patterned chromium electrodes on glass bottom plate (photolithography + etching)
50 nm Teflon-AF hydrophobic coating (spin-coated, 1% wt/wt in Fluorinert FC-40, 1000 rpm, 30 s, post-baked 160 C 10 min)
Unpatterned ITO-coated glass top plate (50 nm Teflon-AF coated)

bottom_plate.electrode_array: 22 square actuation electrodes (2.2 x 2.2 mm each)

assembly.note: Gap > DBS punch thickness (~430 um) to allow punch insertion without crushing

nesi_interface.emitter_type: Pulled-glass capillary nanoESI emitter (New Objective Inc.)
nesi_interface.spray_voltage_kV: 1.7-2.2 DC applied to ITO top plate
nesi_interface.extended_protocol: Two capillary emitters (one per end of device) used for parallel SA and AA analysis (Fig. 6)

pre_extraction_solvent.name: Methanol (MeOH)
pre_extraction_solvent.purpose: Sequential pre-extraction to remove amino acids, acylcarnitines, and other small molecules that interfere with SA derivatization. SA remains in residual blood spot.

sa_extraction_derivatization_ms_solvent.name: HydrazineReagent
sa_extraction_derivatization_ms_solvent.composition: 6.5 mM hydrazine + 15 uM 13C5-SA internal standard in 80:20 acetonitrile:H2O + 0.1% v/v formic acid
sa_extraction_derivatization_ms_solvent.purpose: SA extraction from residual DBS; hydrazine derivatization to hydrazone; formic acid for MS ionization; 13C5-SA as internal standard for quantification

internal_standard.name: 3,4,5,6,7-13C-succinylacetone (13C5-SA)
internal_standard.note: Co-dispensed in HydrazineReagent; modelled as separate manifest InternalStandard_13C5_SA in BioScript

aa_derivatization_reagent.name: AADerivatizationReagent
aa_derivatization_reagent.purpose: Butyl ester derivatization of amino acids for ESI-MS/MS (standard NBS method)

aa_ms_solvent.name: AASolvent
aa_ms_solvent.purpose: Re-dissolution of dried butyl-ester AA derivatives prior to nESI-MS

dbs_sample.name: DBSPunch
dbs_sample.toronto_samples: Male blood units in EDTA (K3) from Biochemed Services; fortified with SA (5, 10, 20, 50, 80 uM) and 15 uM 13C5-SA; 100 uL aliquots spotted; dried overnight at ambient temperature
dbs_sample.ottawa_samples: NSO standard technique (Mei et al. J. Nutr. 2001); stored at -20 C; pre-fortified with 10 uL 13C5-SA (15 uM) and air-dried 2 h at RT before analysis

reagent_total_volume_uL.reduction_note: DMF reduces reagent use by 2.7-4.1x vs conventional technique

feedback_control.system: Impedance-based feedback control (RBBB Arduino microcontroller, Modern Device)
feedback_control.circuit: Buffered voltage measurement with digital potentiometer (Radj = 1-10 kOhm)
feedback_control.failure_response: Step-up 50 Vrms per failed attempt (max 350 Vrms)
feedback_control.relays: 80 AQV259H Panasonic solid-state relays, 2 per output (40 outputs total)
feedback_control.control_software: Custom C++ program interfaced via USB to Arduino
feedback_control.note: First system to implement automated feedback-controlled variation of actuation potentials

ms_detection.instrument: LTQ linear ion trap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)

sa_analysis.tip_washing: 4-5 rinse droplets reduce SA signal below LOD (Fig. 5)

aa_analysis.note: Proof-of-concept, non-quantitative (Fig. 6b); same spray parameters as SA analysis

validation.method: Paired t-test vs NSO gold standard
validation.conclusion: No statistically significant difference between DMF and NSO standard technique
validation.note: Different extraction volumes, techniques, mass spectrometers (different manufacturers), locations, and operators

steps.name: MeOH pre-extraction cycle 1
steps.notes: 15 min incubation at room temperature. Methanol extracts amino acids, acylcarnitines. SA remains in residual spot. MeOH extractate actuated to waste reservoir after incubation.

steps.name: Drain MeOH pre-extractate 1 to waste
steps.notes: In extended AA protocol (Fig. 6), this extractate is retained and diverted for AA derivatization instead. In main SA-only protocol it is discarded.

steps.name: MeOH pre-extraction cycle 2
steps.notes: Second sequential MeOH wash. DBSPunch object reused (persistent solid phase).

steps.name: MeOH pre-extraction cycle 3
steps.notes: Third and final MeOH pre-extraction. Residual punch now ready for hydrazine SA extraction.

steps.name: SA extraction and derivatization - Part A (evaporation)
steps.notes: 6.5 mM hydrazine reagent actuated to residual DBS punch. Incubated at 37 C on hot-plate until evaporation (~15 min). Hydrazine reacts with SA to form hydrazone derivative. Evaporation concentrates derivatized analyte. Reaction mechanism: Sander et al. Clin. Chem. 2006.

steps.name: SA extraction and derivatization - Part B (circular re-dissolution)
steps.notes: Fresh 15 uL hydrazine reagent droplet loaded and actuated to evaporated residual. Incubated 1 min at RT. Droplet actuated in circular pattern around 5 electrodes adjacent to DBS punch to maximise re-dissolution of derivatized SA hydrazone.

steps.name: nESI-MS/MS analysis of derivatized SA
steps.notes: Droplet driven to capillary emitter inlet; fills by capillary action. DC 1.7-2.2 kV applied to ITO top plate. MS/MS: 25% CID, scan m/z 100-300, neutral loss 18 (m/z 155->137 for SA, 160->142 for 13C5-SA). 50 acquisitions averaged.

steps.name: AA extended protocol - MeOH extraction and evaporation
steps.notes: In extended protocol, first MeOH incubation is 5 min (not 15 min). Extractate evaporated to dryness at RT (~15 min) on non-reservoir electrode to concentrate AAs. In BioScript, fresh DBSPunch dispense represents the isolated MeOH extractate (linearization of parallel branch).

steps.name: AA extended protocol - Butyl ester derivatization
steps.notes: 3 N HCl in n-butanol actuated to dried AA extract. Heated to 75 C until dryness. Forms n-butyl ester derivatives of amino acids for ESI-MS/MS.

steps.name: AA extended protocol - Re-dissolution and nESI-MS analysis
steps.notes: ACN:H2O 4:1 solvent re-dissolves dried derivatives. Droplet actuated to second nESI emitter (opposite end of device, Fig. 6a). Primary MS spectrum. AAs detected: VAL, MET, TYR, HIS, GLN, PRO, PHE, ASP.

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: Steps S1-S9: three MeOH pre-extractions, SA extraction/derivatization Parts A+B, nESI-MS/MS detection, AA extended branch (S2a-S2c)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.contents: dispose(saSignal); AA extended protocol S2a-S2c; aaSignal gate
